"""Three real tasks with direct worker-to-worker forwarding and local calls."""

import hashlib
import http.client
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import threading
import time
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from probe import MODEL_URL, MODEL_SHA256, IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_SHA256, fetch, emit
from transport import preprocess, TENSOR_SHA256


def serve():
    import numpy as np
    import onnxruntime as ort

    alias,node,backend=os.environ['ALIAS'],os.environ['NODE_NAME'],os.environ['BACKEND']
    peers=json.loads(os.environ['PEERS_JSON'])
    work=Path(os.environ.get('WORKDIR','/work'))
    asset_base=os.environ.get('ASSET_BASE')
    model_path=work/'model.onnx'
    model_path.write_bytes(fetch(asset_base+'/model.onnx' if asset_base else MODEL_URL,MODEL_SHA256))
    image=fetch(asset_base+'/dog.jpg' if asset_base else IMAGE_URL,IMAGE_SHA256)
    fixture=preprocess(image)
    assert hashlib.sha256(fixture.tobytes()).hexdigest()==TENSOR_SHA256
    opts=ort.SessionOptions();opts.intra_op_num_threads=opts.inter_op_num_threads=1
    session=ort.InferenceSession(str(model_path),opts,providers=['CPUExecutionProvider'])
    reference=session.run(None,{session.get_inputs()[0].name:fixture})[0].reshape(-1)
    corpus={}
    if os.environ.get('CORPUS_FILE'):
        corpus=json.loads(Path(os.environ['CORPUS_FILE']).read_text())
        for sample in corpus.values():
            local=os.environ.get('CORPUS_ASSET_DIR')
            data=(Path(local)/sample['filename']).read_bytes() if local else fetch(
                asset_base+'/corpus/'+sample['filename'],sample['sha256'])
            assert len(data)==sample['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==sample['sha256']
            assert hashlib.sha256(preprocess(data).tobytes()).hexdigest()==sample['tensor_sha256']
    runtime=None
    if os.environ.get('DYNAMIC_LIFECYCLE')=='1':
        from model_lifecycle import ModelRuntime,factory_for
        runtime=ModelRuntime(factory_for(backend,model_path,opts),fixture)
        infer=runtime.run
    elif backend=='gpu':
        from accelerator_inference import gpu_backend
        infer=gpu_backend(model_path,fixture)
    elif backend=='intel_npu':
        from accelerator_inference import npu_backend
        infer=npu_backend(model_path,fixture)
    else:
        assert backend=='cpu'
        def infer(tensor):
            return session.run(None,{session.get_inputs()[0].name:tensor})[0].reshape(-1),{'execution_device':'CPU'}
    for _ in range(2):
        scores,evidence=infer(fixture)
        assert np.argsort(scores)[-5:][::-1].tolist()==[258,259,157,279,152]
    lock=threading.Lock()

    def execute(stage,data,plan,request_id,connections,input_id='dog'):
        sample=corpus[input_id] if corpus else {'bytes':len(image),'sha256':IMAGE_SHA256,'tensor_sha256':TENSOR_SHA256}
        digest=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        if stage==0:
            assert len(data)==sample['bytes'] and digest==sample['sha256']
        elif stage==1:
            assert len(data)==602112 and digest==sample['tensor_sha256']
        else:
            assert stage==2 and len(data)==4000
        started=time.perf_counter()
        if stage==0:
            payload=preprocess(data).tobytes();device={'execution_device':'CPU'}
        elif stage==1:
            tensor=np.frombuffer(data,dtype='<f4').reshape(1,3,224,224).copy()
            with lock:scores,device=infer(tensor)
            payload=np.asarray(scores,dtype='<f4').reshape(-1).tobytes()
        else:
            scores=np.frombuffer(data,dtype='<f4')
            top5=np.argsort(scores)[-5:][::-1].tolist()
            payload=json.dumps(top5).encode();device={'execution_device':'CPU'}
        task_ms=(time.perf_counter()-started)*1000
        if stage==0:assert hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()==sample['tensor_sha256']
        if stage==1:
            assert len(payload)==4000 and np.isfinite(scores).all()
            predicted=np.argsort(scores)[-5:][::-1].tolist()
            if not corpus:assert predicted==[258,259,157,279,152]
            target=np.asarray(sample['reference_scores'],dtype=np.float64) if corpus else reference
            expected=sample['reference_top5'] if corpus else [258,259,157,279,152]
            difference=scores.astype(np.float64)-target
            device={**device,'max_abs_error_vs_cpu':float(np.max(np.abs(difference))),
                    'rmse_vs_cpu':float(np.sqrt(np.mean(difference**2))),
                    'top1_agrees_with_cpu':predicted[0]==expected[0],
                    'top5_overlap_with_cpu':len(set(predicted)&set(expected)),
                    'top5_order_agrees_with_cpu':predicted==expected}
        entry={'stage':stage,'alias':alias,'node':node,'worker_backend':backend,'task_ms':task_ms,
               'input_bytes':len(data),'output_bytes':len(payload),'input_sha256':digest,
               'output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),'device':device,'rpc_next_ms':0.0}
        if corpus:entry['input_id']=input_id
        if stage==2:
            if not corpus:assert top5==[258,259,157,279,152]
            result={'request_id':request_id,'plan':plan,'top5':top5,'trace':[entry]}
            if corpus:result['input_id']=input_id
        else:
            next_alias=plan[stage+1]
            called=time.perf_counter()
            if next_alias==alias:
                child=execute(stage+1,payload,plan,request_id,connections,input_id)
                entry['next_mode']='local_call'
            else:
                now=time.monotonic()
                cached=connections.get(next_alias)
                if cached is not None and now-cached['last_used']>=10:
                    cached['connection'].close()
                    del connections[next_alias]
                reused=next_alias in connections
                if next_alias not in connections:
                    url=urlparse(peers[next_alias]['url'])
                    connection=http.client.HTTPConnection(url.hostname,url.port,timeout=15)
                    connection.connect();connection.sock.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP,socket.TCP_NODELAY,1)
                    connections[next_alias]={'connection':connection,'last_used':now}
                connection=connections[next_alias]['connection']
                assert connection.sock is not None,'Unexpected reconnect'
                connection.request('POST',f'/stage/{stage+1}',payload,
                                   {'X-Plan':json.dumps(plan),'X-Request-ID':request_id,
                                    'X-Payload-SHA256':entry['output_sha256'],'X-Input-ID':input_id})
                response=connection.getresponse()
                assert response.status==200 and int(response.getheader('Content-Length'))<65536
                child=json.loads(response.read())
                assert response.getheader('X-Worker-Alias')==next_alias
                connections[next_alias]['last_used']=time.monotonic()
                entry['next_mode']='http'
                entry['next_connection_reused']=reused
            entry['rpc_next_ms']=(time.perf_counter()-called)*1000
            assert child['request_id']==request_id and child['plan']==plan
            result={**child,'trace':[entry]+child['trace']}
        emit('stage_complete',request_id=request_id,plan=plan,**entry)
        return result

    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        protocol_version='HTTP/1.1'
        disable_nagle_algorithm=True

        def setup(self):
            super().setup();self.connection.settimeout(15);self.connections={}

        def finish(self):
            for cached in self.connections.values():cached['connection'].close()
            super().finish()

        def log_message(self,*_):pass

        def do_GET(self):
            if self.path!='/healthz':self.send_error(404);return
            self.reply({'alias':alias,'node':node,'backend':backend,'model_sha256':MODEL_SHA256,
                        **(runtime.health() if runtime else {})})

        def reply(self,result):
            body=json.dumps(result,allow_nan=False).encode()
            self.send_response(200);self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)))
            self.send_header('X-Worker-Alias',alias);self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body)

        def do_POST(self):
            try:
                if self.path=='/evict' and runtime:
                    assert int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0'))==0
                    result=runtime.evict()
                    emit('model_evicted',alias=alias,**result)
                    self.reply(result)
                    return
                assert self.path in ['/stage/0','/stage/1','/stage/2']
                stage=int(self.path[-1]);plan=json.loads(self.headers['X-Plan'])
                assert len(plan)==3 and all(p in peers for p in plan) and plan[stage]==alias
                input_id=self.headers.get('X-Input-ID','dog')
                assert not corpus or input_id in corpus
                expected=[corpus[input_id]['bytes'] if corpus else len(image),602112,4000][stage]
                assert int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0'))==expected
                data=self.rfile.read(expected)
                assert len(data)==expected and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==self.headers['X-Payload-SHA256']
                result=execute(stage,data,plan,self.headers['X-Request-ID'],self.connections,input_id)
                self.reply(result)
            except (AssertionError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError) as error:
                emit('request_error',error=str(error));self.send_error(400,'Invalid workflow request')

    server=ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0',int(os.environ.get('PORT','8080'))),Handler)
    emit('server_ready',alias=alias,node=node,backend=backend,evidence=evidence)
    server.serve_forever()


def client():
    peers=json.loads(os.environ['PEERS_JSON']);schedule=json.loads(os.environ['SCHEDULE_JSON'])
    asset_base=os.environ.get('ASSET_BASE')
    image=fetch(asset_base+'/dog.jpg' if asset_base else IMAGE_URL,IMAGE_SHA256)
    measured=int(os.environ['MEASURED']);block=os.environ['BLOCK']
    for condition in schedule:
        plan=condition['plan'];url=urlparse(peers[plan[0]]['url'])
        connection=http.client.HTTPConnection(url.hostname,url.port,timeout=15)
        for iteration in range(2+measured):
            request_id=f"{os.environ['RUN_ID']}-{block}-{condition['id']}-{iteration}"
            started=time.perf_counter()
            if connection.sock is None:
                assert iteration==0,'Unexpected ingress reconnect'
                connection.connect();connection.sock.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP,socket.TCP_NODELAY,1)
            connection.request('POST','/stage/0',image,{'X-Plan':json.dumps(plan),'X-Request-ID':request_id,
                                                       'X-Payload-SHA256':IMAGE_SHA256})
            response=connection.getresponse()
            assert response.status==200 and int(response.getheader('Content-Length'))<65536
            result=json.loads(response.read())
            finished=time.perf_counter()
            assert result['request_id']==request_id and result['plan']==plan
            assert result['top5']==[258,259,157,279,152]
            assert [t['alias'] for t in result['trace']]==plan and [t['stage'] for t in result['trace']]==[0,1,2]
            trace=result['trace']
            assert trace[0]['output_sha256']==trace[1]['input_sha256'] and trace[1]['output_sha256']==trace[2]['input_sha256']
            emit('workflow',block=block,condition=condition,iteration=iteration,warmup=iteration<2,
                 workflow_ms=(finished-started)*1000,pacing_overrun=(finished-started)>.25,**result)
            time.sleep(max(0,.25-(time.perf_counter()-started)))
        connection.close()
    emit('client_complete',block=block,conditions=len(schedule),requests=len(schedule)*(2+measured))


if __name__=='__main__':
    if os.environ['MODE']=='server':serve()
    elif os.environ['MODE']=='client':client()
    else:raise ValueError('Invalid MODE')

"""Actual HTTP workflow test, including a worker→worker→original-worker path."""

import hashlib
import http.client
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import selectors
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

from probe import IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_SHA256, fetch


class DAGContract(unittest.TestCase):
    extra_env={}
    aliases=('a','b')
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.directory=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory();cls.processes=[];cls.logs=[]
        cls.peers={};reservations={}
        for alias in cls.aliases:
            sock=socket.socket();sock.bind(('127.0.0.1',0))
            reservations[alias]=sock;port=sock.getsockname()[1]
            cls.peers[alias]={'alias':alias,'node':'local-'+alias,'backend':'cpu','url':f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}'}
        for alias,peer in cls.peers.items():
            work=Path(cls.directory.name)/alias;work.mkdir()
            error=open(work/'stderr.log','w+');cls.logs.append(error)
            env=dict(os.environ,MODE='server',ALIAS=alias,NODE_NAME=peer['node'],BACKEND='cpu',
                     PORT=peer['url'].rsplit(':',1)[1],WORKDIR=str(work),PEERS_JSON=json.dumps(cls.peers))
            env.update(cls.extra_env)
            reservations.pop(alias).close()
            p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-u',str(Path(__file__).with_name('dag_profile.py'))],
                               env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=error,text=True)
            cls.processes.append(p)
            selector=selectors.DefaultSelector();selector.register(p.stdout,selectors.EVENT_READ)
            while selector.select(timeout=60):
                line=p.stdout.readline()
                if not line:break
                if json.loads(line)['kind']=='server_ready':break
            else:line=''
            selector.close()
            if not line or json.loads(line)['kind']!='server_ready':
                error.seek(0);message=error.read()[-1500:]
                for process in cls.processes:
                    if process.poll() is None:process.terminate();process.wait(timeout=5)
                for reservation in reservations.values():reservation.close()
                raise AssertionError(message)
        cls.body=fetch(IMAGE_URL,IMAGE_SHA256)

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        for p in cls.processes:
            p.terminate();p.wait(timeout=5);p.stdout.close()
        for log in cls.logs:log.close()
        cls.directory.cleanup()

    def test_colocated_and_forwarded_workflows_preserve_task_data(self):
        a,b=self.aliases
        for plan in [[a,a,a],[a,b,a]]:
            with self.subTest(plan=plan):
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',int(self.peers[a]['url'].rsplit(':',1)[1]),timeout=15)
                conn.request('POST','/stage/0',self.body,{'X-Plan':json.dumps(plan),'X-Request-ID':'test-'+''.join(plan),
                                                       'X-Payload-SHA256':hashlib.sha256(self.body).hexdigest()})
                response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
                self.assertEqual(response.status,200)
                self.assertEqual(result['top5'],[258,259,157,279,152])
                self.assertEqual([t['alias'] for t in result['trace']],plan)
                self.assertEqual([t['stage'] for t in result['trace']],[0,1,2])
                self.assertEqual(result['trace'][0]['output_sha256'],result['trace'][1]['input_sha256'])
                self.assertEqual(result['trace'][1]['output_sha256'],result['trace'][2]['input_sha256'])


if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()

"""Keep client health connections active while only nested forwarding becomes idle."""

import time

from policy_runner import PolicyRunner
import test_policy_runner as fixtures


class IdleForwardingHTTP(fixtures.DAGContract):
    extra_env=fixtures.PolicyWorkflowHTTP.extra_env
    profile=fixtures.PolicyWorkflowHTTP.profile

    def test_nested_route_survives_idle_without_retrying_the_post(self):
        with PolicyRunner(self.peers) as runner:
            def run(name,plan):
                return runner.run(request_id=name,input_id='dog',body=self.body,source='a',
                                  profile=self.profile(),policy_name='idle-route',policy=lambda s:plan)
            self.assertEqual(run('idle-before',['a','b','a'])['status'],'ok')
            for index in range(4):
                time.sleep(4)
                row=run(f'idle-local-{index}',['a','a','a'])
                self.assertEqual(row['status'],'ok',row.get('error'))
            after=run('idle-after',['a','b','a'])
            self.assertEqual(after['status'],'ok',after.get('error'))
            self.assertEqual(after['result']['top5'],[258,259,157,279,152])
            self.assertFalse(after['result']['trace'][0]['next_connection_reused'])

"""Collect warm calibration or apply previously frozen, deduplicated plans."""

from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

from policy_runner import PolicyRunner
from probe import MODEL_SHA256,fetch,emit


def main():
    spec=json.load(sys.stdin);peers=json.loads(os.environ['PEERS_JSON'])
    corpus=json.loads(Path(os.environ['CORPUS_FILE']).read_text())
    source=spec['source'];mode=spec['mode'];aliases=sorted(peers)
    images={}
    for key,sample in corpus.items():
        path=Path('/work')/sample['filename']
        if not path.exists():path.write_bytes(fetch(os.environ['ASSET_BASE']+'/corpus/'+sample['filename'],sample['sha256']))
        images[key]=path.read_bytes()
        assert hashlib.sha256(images[key]).hexdigest()==sample['sha256']
    count=0
    with PolicyRunner(peers) as runner:
        for condition in spec['conditions']:
            key=condition['image_id'];plan=condition['plan']
            if mode=='calibration':
                profile={'id':f"{spec['run_id']}-cal-{source}-{key}",
                    'provenance':'Calibration collection only; costs not yet measured',
                    'input_id':key,'source':source,'model_sha256':MODEL_SHA256,
                    'candidates':[list(aliases) for _ in range(3)],
                    'cost_ms':{'task':{f'{i}|{a}':None for i in range(3) for a in aliases},
                               'ingress':{a:None for a in aliases},
                               'edges':[{f'{a}|{b}':None for a in aliases for b in aliases} for _ in range(2)],
                               'service_prepare':{a:None for a in aliases}}}
                warmups=1;measured=3
            else:
                assert mode=='evaluation'
                profile=spec['profiles'][source+'|'+key]
                warmups=2;measured=5

            def apply_frozen(snapshot):
                if not snapshot['workers'][plan[1]]['service_object_ready']:
                    raise ValueError('Warm-only placement encountered an unready inference service')
                return plan

            for iteration in range(warmups+measured):
                started=time.perf_counter()
                row=runner.run(request_id=f"{spec['run_id']}-b{spec['block']}-{mode}-{source}-{condition['id']}-{iteration}",
                    input_id=key,body=images[key],source=source,profile=profile,
                    policy_name='calibration-fixed-plan' if mode=='calibration' else 'frozen-plan-group',policy=apply_frozen)
                valid=row['status']=='ok' and row['result']['top5']==corpus[key]['reference_top5']
                emit('workflow',mode=mode,source=source,block=spec['block'],condition=condition,
                     iteration=iteration,warmup=iteration<warmups,valid_complete=valid,
                     completed_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                     pacing_overrun=(time.perf_counter()-started)>.25,**row)
                count+=1
                if mode=='calibration' and row['status']!='ok':
                    raise RuntimeError('Calibration failure recorded; cannot freeze incomplete costs')
                time.sleep(max(0,.25-(time.perf_counter()-started)))
    emit('client_complete',mode=mode,source=source,block=spec['block'],requests=count)


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Warm placement choices are applied through real HTTP workers."""

import itertools
import json
from pathlib import Path

from policy_runner import PolicyRunner
from test_policy_runner import PolicyWorkflowHTTP


class FreshPlacementHTTP(PolicyWorkflowHTTP):
    def test_dag_avoids_the_worked_greedy_trap_and_executes_the_chosen_route(self):
        from fresh_placement import data_greedy,dag_enumeration

        profile=self.profile()
        # Worked costs: greedy A,B,B=13ms; global B,B,B=4ms.
        profile['cost_ms']['task']={'0|a':1,'0|b':2,'1|a':20,'1|b':1,'2|a':1,'2|b':1}
        profile['cost_ms']['ingress']={'a':0,'b':0}
        profile['cost_ms']['edges']=[{'a|a':0,'a|b':10,'b|a':10,'b|b':0} for _ in range(2)]

        def policy(snapshot):
            self.assertEqual(data_greedy(snapshot),['a','b','b'])
            self.assertEqual(dag_enumeration(snapshot),['b','b','b'])
            return dag_enumeration(snapshot)

        with PolicyRunner(self.peers) as runner:
            row=runner.run(request_id='dag-worked-trap',input_id='dog',body=self.body,source='a',
                           profile=profile,policy_name='dag-worked-example',policy=policy)
        self.assertEqual(row['status'],'ok',row.get('error'))
        self.assertEqual(row['plan'],['b','b','b'])
        self.assertEqual(row['result']['top5'],[258,259,157,279,152])

    def test_http_calibration_freezes_candidates_and_refuses_an_unmet_quality_contract(self):
        from fresh_placement import freeze_profiles,dag_enumeration

        rows=[]
        with PolicyRunner(self.peers) as runner:
            for index,plan in enumerate(itertools.product(['a','b'],repeat=3)):
                row=runner.run(request_id=f'quality-cal-{index}',input_id='dog',body=self.body,source='a',
                               profile=self.profile(),policy_name='calibration',policy=lambda s,p=plan:p)
                self.assertEqual(row['status'],'ok',row.get('error'))
                row.update(source='a',warmup=False);rows.append(row)
            sample=json.loads(Path(self.extra_env['CORPUS_FILE']).read_text())['dog']
            profiles,quality=freeze_profiles(rows,{'dog':sample},['a','b'],'http-calibration-evidence')
            profile=profiles['a|dog']
            self.assertEqual(profile['candidates'],[['a','b'],['a','b'],['a','b']])
            self.assertTrue(quality['dog']['b']['eligible'])
            evaluated=runner.run(request_id='quality-heldout',input_id='dog',body=self.body,source='a',
                                 profile=profile,policy_name='calibrated-dag',policy=dag_enumeration)
            self.assertEqual(evaluated['status'],'ok',evaluated.get('error'))
            self.assertEqual(evaluated['result']['top5'],[258,259,157,279,152])
        unmet={'dog':{**sample,'reference_top5':[0,1,2,3,4]}}
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'quality'):
            freeze_profiles(rows,unmet,['a','b'],'unmet-quality-fixture')

"""Fresh warm calibration, immutable placement freeze, and temporal holdout."""

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import copy
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import itertools
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tarfile
import time
import urllib.request

import pandas as pd

from fresh_placement import POLICIES,freeze_profiles,plan_cost
from policy_runner import readonly


def main():
    base=Path('artifacts/fresh-placement');base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    assert not (base/'run.json').exists(),'Preserve all prior attempts'
    began=time.perf_counter();namespace='scheduler-research'
    run_id=datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dt%H%M%S%f');prefix='fresh-place-'+run_id
    labels={'app.kubernetes.io/part-of':'scheduler-research','research.scheduler/stage':'fresh-placement','research.scheduler/run':run_id}
    meta=lambda name:{'name':name,'namespace':namespace,'labels':copy.deepcopy(labels)}
    cmd=['rtk','proxy','kubectl','--request-timeout=20s','-n',namespace]
    def call(*args):return subprocess.check_output([*cmd,*args],text=True)
    def write(name,data):
        path=base/name;assert not path.exists(),f'Preserve attempt {name}'
        path.write_text(data if isinstance(data,str) else json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    def records(raw):return [json.loads(line) for line in raw.splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
    def protected():
        pods=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['rtk','proxy','kubectl','--request-timeout=20s','get','pods','-A','-o','json'],text=True))['items']
        names={p['name'] for p in json.loads(Path('artifacts/measured-policy-bridge/preexisting-after-cleanup.json').read_text())}
        return [{'name':p['metadata']['name'],'namespace':p['metadata']['namespace'],'node':p['spec'].get('nodeName'),
                 'phase':p['status']['phase'],'ready':next((c['status'] for c in p['status'].get('conditions',[]) if c['type']=='Ready'),None)}
                for p in pods if p['metadata']['name'] in names]
    loader=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('allocation','/home/jinuk/.codex/skills/experimental-design/scripts/randomization.py')
    allocation=importlib.util.module_from_spec(loader);loader.loader.exec_module(allocation)
    def assigned(rows,seed):return allocation.assign_factorial_runs(pd.DataFrame(rows),seed=seed).to_dict('records')
    old=Path('artifacts/measured-policy-bridge');e3=Path('artifacts/e3-input-replication')
    corpus=json.loads((e3/'corpus.json').read_text());write('corpus.json',corpus)

    cache=json.loads((old/'cache.json').read_text())['items']
    old_endpoint=next(e['value'] for p in old_items if p['kind']=='Pod' for e in p['spec']['containers'][0]['env'] if e['name']=='ASSET_BASE')
    old_host=old_endpoint.split('://')[1].split(':')[0]
    cache_name=prefix+'-cache';host=cache_name+'.'+namespace+'.svc.cluster.local';endpoint='http://'+host+':8080'
    for item in cache:
        item['metadata']=meta(cache_name);item['metadata']['labels']['research.scheduler/worker']='cache'

    cm=json.loads((old/'configmap.json').read_text());cm['metadata']=meta(prefix)

            name=block_prefix+'-'+alias.replace('_','-')+('-client' if role=='client' else '')
            item['metadata']=meta(name);item['metadata']['labels'].update({'research.scheduler/block':str(block),'research.scheduler/alias':alias,'research.scheduler/role':role})
            item['spec']['activeDeadlineSeconds']=900
            for volume in item['spec']['volumes']:
                if 'configMap' in volume:volume['configMap']['name']=prefix
            c=item['spec']['containers'][0]
            if role=='worker':
                c['command'][-1]=c['command'][-1].replace(old_endpoint,endpoint).replace(old_host,host)
                workers[alias]=name
            else:clients[alias]=name
            for env in c['env']:
                if env['name']=='PEERS_JSON':env['value']=json.dumps(peers)
                elif env['name']=='ASSET_BASE':env['value']=endpoint
                elif env['name'] in ['NO_PROXY','no_proxy']:env['value']=host
            items.append(item)
        for alias,name in workers.items():
            pod=next(p for p in items if p['metadata']['name']==name)
            items.append({'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Service','metadata':meta(name),
                          'spec':{'selector':pod['metadata']['labels'],'ports':[{'port':8080,'targetPort':8080}]}})
        calibration={source:assigned([{'id':key+'-'+','.join(plan),'image_id':key,'plan':list(plan)}
            for key,plan in itertools.product(corpus,itertools.product(aliases,repeat=3))],20261111+10*block+i)
            for i,source in enumerate(aliases)}
        design={'block':block,'workers':workers,'clients':clients,'targets':peers,
                'calibration_source_order':[r['source'] for r in assigned([{'source':a} for a in aliases],20261101+block)],
                'evaluation_source_order':[r['source'] for r in assigned([{'source':a} for a in aliases],20261121+block)],
                'calibration':calibration}
        deployments.append(design);objects.extend(items)
        write(f'deployment-b{block}.json',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'List','items':items})
    edge=json.loads((old/'postcheck.json').read_text());edge['metadata']=meta(prefix+'-edge-check');objects.append(edge)
    for block in range(3):objects.append({'kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':meta(prefix+f'-profile-b{block}')})
    assert all(o['metadata']['name'].startswith(prefix) and o['metadata']['namespace']==namespace for o in objects)
    write('cache.json',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'List','items':cache});write('configmap.json',cm);write('postcheck.json',edge)
    manifest=json.loads((old/'wheel-manifest.json').read_text());write('wheel-manifest.json',manifest)
    source_hashes={name:hashlib.sha256(data.encode()).hexdigest() for name,data in cm['data'].items() if name.endswith('.py')}
    write('run.json',{'run_id':run_id,'namespace':namespace,'prefix':prefix,'design_frozen_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
         'deployments':deployments,'source_sha256':source_hashes,'calibration_workflows_per_block':512,
         'corpus_sha256':hashlib.sha256((e3/'corpus.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
         'quality_rule':'exact CPU-reference Top5 order in every calibration observation',
         'scope':'Warm static placement with temporal holdout; shared plans share execution observations.'})
    wheelhouse=base/'wheelhouse';wheelhouse.mkdir(exist_ok=True);mutations=False;identities=[];totals=[]

    def remove(items):
        for item in reversed(items):
            name=item['metadata']['name'];kind=item['kind'].lower()
            raw=call('get',kind,name,'--ignore-not-found','-o','json')
            if not raw.strip():continue
            actual=json.loads(raw)
            assert actual['metadata']['labels'].get('research.scheduler/run')==run_id,'Ownership mismatch'
            subprocess.run([*cmd,'delete',kind,name,'--wait=false'],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)

    try:
        existing=json.loads(call('get','pods,services,configmaps','-o','json'))['items']
        names={(o['kind'],o['metadata']['name']) for o in objects}
        assert not any((o['kind'],o['metadata']['name']) in names for o in existing),'Owned name collision'
        allpods=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['rtk','proxy','kubectl','--request-timeout=20s','get','pods','-A','-o','json'],text=True))['items']
        claims=[p['metadata']['name'] for p in allpods if p['spec'].get('nodeName')==old_run['targets']['intel_npu']['node'] and
            p['status']['phase'] not in ['Succeeded','Failed'] and any(any('npu' in key for key in c.get('resources',{}).get(g,{}))
            for c in p['spec']['containers'] for g in ['requests','limits'])]
        write('preflight.json',{'npu_claims':claims,'owned_collisions':0});assert not claims,'NPU already in use'
        before=protected();write('preexisting-before.json',before)
        assert len(before)==3 and all(p['phase']=='Running' and p['ready']=='True' for p in before)
        def download(w):
            p=wheelhouse/w['filename']
            with urllib.request.urlopen(w['url'],timeout=60) as response:p.write_bytes(response.read())
            assert p.stat().st_size==w['size'] and hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==w['sha256']
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as pool:list(pool.map(download,manifest))
        mutations=True;subprocess.run([*cmd,'create','-f',str(base/'cache.json')],check=True)
        subprocess.run([*cmd,'wait','--for=condition=Ready','pod/'+cache_name,'--timeout=60s'],check=True)
        upload=subprocess.Popen([*cmd,'exec','-i',cache_name,'--','python3','-c',
            "import sys,tarfile;tarfile.open(fileobj=sys.stdin.buffer,mode='r|').extractall('/work',filter='data')"],stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=upload.stdin,mode='w|') as archive:
            for p in wheelhouse.iterdir():archive.add(p,arcname=p.name)
            for p in (e3/'assets').iterdir():archive.add(p,arcname=p.name)
        upload.stdin.close();assert upload.wait(timeout=60)==0
        subprocess.run([*cmd,'create','-f',str(base/'configmap.json')],check=True)
        for design in deployments:
            block=design['block'];prep_started=time.perf_counter()
            subprocess.run([*cmd,'create','-f',str(base/f'deployment-b{block}.json')],check=True)
            ready=set();deadline=time.monotonic()+240
            while len(ready)!=2:
                for alias,name in design['workers'].items():
                    p=json.loads(call('get','pod',name,'-o','json'))
                    if p['status']['phase']=='Pending':continue
                    raw=call('logs',name);(base/f'worker-b{block}-{alias}.log').write_text(raw)
                    assert p['status']['phase']=='Running',f'Worker failed: {alias}'
                    if any(r['kind']=='server_ready' for r in records(raw)):ready.add(alias)
                print(json.dumps({'kind':'preparing','block':block,'ready':sorted(ready)}),flush=True)
                assert time.monotonic()<deadline,'Hard worker preparation timeout'
                if len(ready)!=2:time.sleep(5)
            prep_seconds=time.perf_counter()-prep_started
            for name in design['clients'].values():
                subprocess.run([*cmd,'wait','--for=condition=Ready','pod/'+name,'--timeout=60s'],check=True)

            def phase(mode,source,conditions,profiles=None):
                spec={'run_id':run_id,'block':block,'source':source,'mode':mode,'conditions':conditions}
                if profiles is not None:spec['profiles']=profiles
                stem=f'{mode}-b{block}-{source}';write(stem+'.input.json',spec)
                started=time.perf_counter()
                result=subprocess.run([*cmd,'exec','-i',design['clients'][source],'--','python3','-u','-c',
                    "import sys,runpy;sys.path.insert(0,'/config');runpy.run_path('/config/fresh_client.py',run_name='__main__')"],
                    input=json.dumps(spec),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
                write(stem+'.log',result.stdout);write(stem+'.stderr',result.stderr)
                assert result.returncode==0,f'Failed phase preserved: {stem}'
                result_rows=records(result.stdout);assert result_rows[-1]['kind']=='client_complete'
                print(json.dumps({'kind':'phase_complete','block':block,'mode':mode,'source':source,
                                  'requests':result_rows[-1]['requests']}),flush=True)
                return [r for r in result_rows if r['kind']=='workflow'],time.perf_counter()-started

            calibration=[];calibration_seconds=0
            for source in design['calibration_source_order']:
                rr,elapsed=phase('calibration',source,design['calibration'][source]);calibration+=rr;calibration_seconds+=elapsed
            assert len(calibration)==512
            hashes={source:hashlib.sha256((base/f'calibration-b{block}-{source}.log').read_bytes()).hexdigest() for source in aliases}
            evidence_id=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(hashes,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
            profiles,quality=freeze_profiles(calibration,corpus,aliases,evidence_id)
            selections={};groups=[]
            for key,profile in profiles.items():
                planning_input=readonly({'profile':profile});chosen={};grouped={}
                for name,policy in POLICIES.items():
                    t=time.perf_counter();plan=policy(planning_input);duration=(time.perf_counter()-t)*1000
                    chosen[name]={'plan':plan,'planning_ms':duration,'estimated_workflow_ms':plan_cost(profile,plan)}
                    grouped.setdefault(tuple(plan),[]).append(name)
                selections[key]=chosen
                for plan,members in sorted(grouped.items()):
                    groups.append({'id':profile['input_id']+'-'+','.join(plan),'image_id':profile['input_id'],
                                   'source':profile['source'],'plan':list(plan),'members':members})
            frozen={'profiles':profiles,'quality':quality,'selections':selections,'calibration_log_sha256':hashes,
                    'frozen_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'preparation_seconds':prep_seconds,
                    'calibration_seconds':calibration_seconds,'source_sha256':source_hashes}
            write(f'frozen-b{block}.json',frozen)
            profile_cm={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':meta(prefix+f'-profile-b{block}'),'immutable':True,
                        'data':{'frozen.json':json.dumps(frozen)}}
            write(f'profile-configmap-b{block}.json',profile_cm)
            subprocess.run([*cmd,'create','-f',str(base/f'profile-configmap-b{block}.json')],check=True)
            frozen_digest=hashlib.sha256((base/f'frozen-b{block}.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            schedules={source:assigned([g for g in groups if g['source']==source],20261131+10*block+i) for i,source in enumerate(aliases)}
            write(f'evaluation-design-b{block}.json',{'groups':len(groups),'schedules':schedules,'frozen_sha256':frozen_digest})
            print(json.dumps({'kind':'profiles_frozen','block':block,'unique_plans':len(groups),
                              'excluded_inference_candidates':[(key,a) for key,q in quality.items() for a,e in q.items() if not e['eligible']]}),flush=True)
            evaluation=[];evaluation_seconds=0
            for source in design['evaluation_source_order']:
                rr,elapsed=phase('evaluation',source,schedules[source],profiles);evaluation+=rr;evaluation_seconds+=elapsed
            assert len(evaluation)==7*len(groups)
            assert hashlib.sha256((base/f'frozen-b{block}.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==frozen_digest
            live_profile=json.loads(call('get','configmap',profile_cm['metadata']['name'],'-o','json'))
            assert live_profile['data']==profile_cm['data']
            receipts=[]
            for alias,name in design['workers'].items():
                raw=call('logs',name);(base/f'worker-b{block}-{alias}.log').write_text(raw)
                receipts.extend(r for r in records(raw) if r['kind']=='stage_complete')
            for row in [*calibration,*evaluation]:
                if row['status']!='ok':continue
                returned=row['result']['trace'];rr=[r for r in receipts if r['request_id']==row['request_id']]
                assert len(rr)==3
                for actual,client in zip(sorted(rr,key=lambda r:r['stage']),returned):
                    assert all(actual[k]==client[k] for k in ['stage','node','alias','input_sha256','output_sha256','task_ms'])
                    assert actual['node']==design['targets'][actual['alias']]['node']
                    if actual['stage']==1 and actual['alias']=='intel_npu':assert actual['device']['execution_devices']==['NPU']
                    else:assert actual['device']['execution_device']=='CPU'
                if row['mode']=='evaluation':
                    assert row['completed_at']>=frozen['frozen_at']
                    assert row['plan'][1] in profiles[row['source']+'|'+row['input_id']]['candidates'][1]
            pods=json.loads(call('get','pods','-l','research.scheduler/run='+run_id+',research.scheduler/block='+str(block),'-o','json'))
            write(f'pods-b{block}.json',pods)
            for pod in pods['items']:
                assert pod['status']['phase']=='Running' and all(c['ready'] and c['restartCount']==0 for c in pod['status']['containerStatuses'])
                identities.append({'block':block,'name':pod['metadata']['name'],'uid':pod['metadata']['uid'],
                    'node':pod['spec']['nodeName'],'container_ids':[c['containerID'] for c in pod['status']['containerStatuses']]})
            totals.append({'block':block,'calibration':len(calibration),'evaluation':len(evaluation),
                           'evaluation_measured':sum(not r['warmup'] for r in evaluation),'unique_plans':len(groups),
                           'workflow_failures':sum(r['status']!='ok' for r in evaluation),
                           'invalid_quality':sum(r['status']=='ok' and not r['valid_complete'] for r in evaluation),
                           'stage_receipts':3*sum(r['status']=='ok' for r in [*calibration,*evaluation]),
                           'evaluation_seconds':evaluation_seconds})
            write(f'block-verification-b{block}.json',totals[-1])
            remove(json.loads((base/f'deployment-b{block}.json').read_text())['items'])
            deadline=time.monotonic()+90
            while json.loads(call('get','pods','-l','research.scheduler/run='+run_id+',research.scheduler/block='+str(block),'-o','json'))['items']:
                assert time.monotonic()<deadline,'Previous block cleanup pending; never force delete'
                time.sleep(2)
            print(json.dumps({'kind':'block_complete','block':block,**totals[-1]}),flush=True)
        write('pod-identities.json',identities);assert len({p['uid'] for p in identities})==12
        live=json.loads(call('get','configmap',prefix,'-o','json'));assert live['data']==cm['data']
        write('live-source-verification.json',{'matches_frozen':True})
        write('verification.json',{'blocks':totals,'completed_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                                 'duration_seconds':time.perf_counter()-began,'source_matches_frozen':True})
        subprocess.run([*cmd,'create','-f',str(base/'postcheck.json')],check=True)
        deadline=time.monotonic()+60
        while True:
            state=json.loads(call('get','pod',edge['metadata']['name'],'-o','json'))['status']['phase']
            if state=='Succeeded':break
            assert state!='Failed' and time.monotonic()<deadline,'Read-only EdgeCore check failed'
            time.sleep(2)
        write('edge-snapshot.json',json.loads(call('logs',edge['metadata']['name'])))
    except BaseException as error:
        for design in deployments:
            for alias,name in design['workers'].items():
                diagnostic=subprocess.run([*cmd,'logs',name],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
                if diagnostic.returncode==0:
                    write(f"failure-worker-b{design['block']}-{alias}.log",diagnostic.stdout)
        write('failure.json',{'type':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error),'at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})
        raise
    finally:
        if mutations:
            remove(objects);deadline=time.monotonic()+90
            while json.loads(call('get','pods,services,configmaps','-l','research.scheduler/run='+run_id,'-o','json'))['items']:
                assert time.monotonic()<deadline,'Final cleanup pending; never force delete'
                time.sleep(2)
        removed=0
        for w in manifest:
            p=wheelhouse/w['filename']
            if p.exists():p.unlink();removed+=1
        after=protected();write('preexisting-after-cleanup.json',after)
        write('cleanup.json',{'completed_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'remaining_owned_resources':0,
                              'removed_wheels':removed,'namespace_retained':True,'production_configuration_changed':False})
        assert len(after)==3 and all(p['phase']=='Running' and p['ready']=='True' for p in after)
    print(json.dumps({'kind':'complete','blocks':len(totals),'owned_resources_remaining':0}),flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Descriptive paired summaries; shared placement observations are counted once."""

from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics


def describe(values):
    return {'n':len(values),'mean':statistics.mean(values),'median':statistics.median(values),
            'sd':statistics.stdev(values) if len(values)>1 else None,'min':min(values),'max':max(values)} if values else None


def main():
    base=Path('artifacts/fresh-placement');assert not (base/'results.json').exists()
    run=json.loads((base/'run.json').read_text());verification=json.loads((base/'verification.json').read_text())
    corpus=json.loads((base/'corpus.json').read_text());episodes=[];comparisons=[];policy_cases=[];quality=[]
    all_rows=[];frozen_all=[];phase_time_order=[]
    for design in run['deployments']:
        block=design['block'];frozen=json.loads((base/f'frozen-b{block}.json').read_text());frozen_all.append(frozen)
        evaluation_design=json.loads((base/f'evaluation-design-b{block}.json').read_text())
        assert hashlib.sha256((base/f'frozen-b{block}.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==evaluation_design['frozen_sha256']
        for source,digest in frozen['calibration_log_sha256'].items():
            assert hashlib.sha256((base/f'calibration-b{block}-{source}.log').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
        rows=[]
        for mode in ['calibration','evaluation']:
            for source in ['arm','intel_npu']:
                path=base/f'{mode}-b{block}-{source}.log'
                rows.extend(json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('{') and json.loads(line).get('kind')=='workflow')
        all_rows+=rows
        calibration=[r for r in rows if r['mode']=='calibration'];evaluation=[r for r in rows if r['mode']=='evaluation']
        assert len(calibration)==512
        for row in rows:
            if row['status']!='ok':continue
            sample=corpus[row['input_id']];trace=row['result']['trace']
            assert trace[0]['input_sha256']==sample['sha256']
            assert trace[0]['output_sha256']==trace[1]['input_sha256']==sample['tensor_sha256']
            assert trace[1]['output_sha256']==trace[2]['input_sha256']
            assert not trace[1]['device']['was_cold']
            assert abs(sum(row['timings_ms'].values())-row['total_ms'])<1e-6
            if row['mode']=='evaluation':
                p=frozen['profiles'][row['source']+'|'+row['input_id']]
                assert row['snapshot']['profile']==p
                assert row['plan'][1] in p['candidates'][1]
        for key,devices in frozen['quality'].items():
            for alias,entry in devices.items():quality.append({'block':block,'input_id':key,'alias':alias,**entry})
        grouped=defaultdict(list)
        for row in evaluation:
            if not row['warmup']:grouped[(row['source'],row['input_id'],tuple(row['condition']['plan']))].append(row)
        indexed={}
        for (source,key,plan),rr in grouped.items():
            assert len(rr)==5
            members=rr[0]['condition']['members'];assert all(r['condition']['members']==members for r in rr)
            identifier=f"b{block}|{source}|{key}|{','.join(plan)}"
            episode={'id':identifier,'block':block,'source':source,'input_id':key,'plan':list(plan),'members':members,
                     'attempts':len(rr),'valid_complete':sum(r['valid_complete'] for r in rr),
                     'workflow_failures':sum(r['status']!='ok' for r in rr),
                     'quality_failures':sum(r['status']=='ok' and not r['valid_complete'] for r in rr),
                     'total_ms':describe([r['total_ms'] for r in rr]),
                     'workflow_ms':describe([r['timings_ms']['workflow'] for r in rr if r['status']=='ok']),
                     'request_ids':[r['request_id'] for r in rr]}
            episodes.append(episode)
            for member in members:indexed[(source,key,member)]=episode
        for source,key in ((s,k) for s in ['arm','intel_npu'] for k in corpus):
            for name in ['task_fastest','data_greedy','dag_enumeration']:
                episode=indexed[(source,key,name)]
                assert episode['plan']==frozen['selections'][source+'|'+key][name]['plan']
                policy_cases.append({'block':block,'source':source,'input_id':key,'policy':name,'episode_id':episode['id'],
                                     'plan':episode['plan'],'mean_total_ms':episode['total_ms']['mean'],
                                     'valid_complete':episode['valid_complete'],'attempts':episode['attempts']})
            dag=indexed[(source,key,'dag_enumeration')]
            for baseline in ['task_fastest','data_greedy']:
                other=indexed[(source,key,baseline)]
                valid=dag['valid_complete']==5 and other['valid_complete']==5
                delta=other['total_ms']['mean']-dag['total_ms']['mean'] if valid else None
                comparisons.append({'block':block,'source':source,'input_id':key,'baseline':baseline,
                    'same_plan':other['id']==dag['id'],'quality_controlled':valid,'baseline_plan':other['plan'],'dag_plan':dag['plan'],
                    'baseline_minus_dag_ms':delta,'relative_reduction_percent':100*delta/other['total_ms']['mean'] if valid else None})
        phase_time_order.append({'block':block,'calibration_last_mtime_ns':max((base/f'calibration-b{block}-{s}.log').stat().st_mtime_ns for s in ['arm','intel_npu']),
            'freeze_mtime_ns':(base/f'frozen-b{block}.json').stat().st_mtime_ns,
            'evaluation_first_spec_mtime_ns':min((base/f'evaluation-b{block}-{s}.input.json').stat().st_mtime_ns for s in ['arm','intel_npu'])})
    for times in phase_time_order:
        assert times['calibration_last_mtime_ns']<times['freeze_mtime_ns']<times['evaluation_first_spec_mtime_ns']
    summary=[]
    for source in ['arm','intel_npu','both']:
        for name in ['task_fastest','data_greedy','dag_enumeration']:
            per_block=[]
            for block in range(3):
                rows=[r for r in policy_cases if r['block']==block and r['policy']==name and (source=='both' or r['source']==source)]
                per_block.append({'block':block,'case_mean_total_ms':statistics.mean(r['mean_total_ms'] for r in rows),
                                  'case_count':len(rows),'valid_complete':sum(r['valid_complete'] for r in rows),
                                  'shared_observation_attempts':sum(r['attempts'] for r in rows)})
            summary.append({'source':source,'policy':name,'blocks':per_block,
                            'block_mean_summary':describe([r['case_mean_total_ms'] for r in per_block])})

            'evaluation_workflows':sum(r['mode']=='evaluation' for r in all_rows),'evaluation_measured_workflows':len(measured),

            'phase_durations':verification,'interpretation_limits':['No independent hardware/day samples','No unseen-image holdout','CPU-reference agreement is not accuracy',

              'No p-values/confidence intervals/p95/SLO superiority or equivalence claims','Small DAG enumeration is not AnchorDL reproduction']}

"""Display deployment-level paired means without inferential error bars."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def main():
    base=Path('artifacts/fresh-placement')
    result=json.loads((base/'results.json').read_text())
    inputs=list(json.loads((base/'corpus.json').read_text()))
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,7),sharex=True,layout='constrained')
    baselines=[('task_fastest','Task-fastest','#2563eb',-.16),
               ('data_greedy','Data-aware greedy','#d97706',.16)]
    markers=['o','s','^']
    for ax,source,title in zip(axes,['arm','intel_npu'],['Input at ARM edge','Input at Intel NPU server']):
        ax.axhline(0,color='#64748b',linewidth=1)
        for name,label,color,offset in baselines:
            for i,key in enumerate(inputs):
                rows=[r for r in result['paired_comparisons'] if r['source']==source and
                      r['input_id']==key and r['baseline']==name and r['quality_controlled']]
                values=[r['baseline_minus_dag_ms'] for r in rows]
                for row in rows:
                    ax.scatter(i+offset+(row['block']-1)*.055,row['baseline_minus_dag_ms'],
                               marker=markers[row['block']],color=color,s=30,alpha=.7)
                if values:
                    ax.plot([i+offset-.11,i+offset+.11],[statistics.mean(values)]*2,
                            color=color,linewidth=2.5)
            ax.scatter([],[],label=label,color=color,s=30)
        ax.set_title(title,loc='left',fontsize=12)
        ax.set_ylabel('Baseline minus DAG (ms)')
        ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.2)
        ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
        ax.legend(loc='upper right',frameon=False)
    axes[-1].set_xticks(range(len(inputs)),[key.replace('hubble_deep_field','hubble') for key in inputs])
    axes[-1].tick_params(axis='x',rotation=15)
    fig.suptitle('Warm static placement: observed paired differences',fontsize=15)
    fig.supxlabel('Points: three deployments on the same hosts/date; bars: their mean. Positive = DAG faster.\n'
                  'Each point compares five measured requests per plan. Identical plans share observations (zero).',fontsize=10)
    for extension in ['png','svg']:
        fig.savefig(base/f'paired-differences.{extension}',dpi=180)
    plt.close(fig)


if __name__=='__main__':main()
